name: Preview spend per day
description: The abuse canary. The bot check, the rate limits and the cache should keep this near-flat; a spike means one of the three is being defeated. Preview events carry target_domain as a property and no domain group, because a stranger's browsing is not a merchant's cost.

name: Preview cache-hit rate
description: The entire cost model for the logged-out preview assumes this stays high. If it falls, the preview stops being nearly free without anything else looking wrong.

name: Preview spend per signup
description: The actual "is the lure worth it" number: what we spend on strangers, against how many of them sign up.

name: Preview economics
description: Total preview spend per day, cache-hit rate, and spend per acquired signup — the three numbers that say whether the free preview is paying for itself or being farmed.

name: Daily preview spend is over its own cap
description: Previews have no domain group to trip on, so this is its own alert rather than part of the per-domain one. If it fires at all, the bot check or the cache is being defeated — investigate, do not raise the cap.
